topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: I can't help but turn the pages of the magazine again, the one with the glossy photos of extravagant homes and lavish lifestyles. I never thought I'd see my neighbor's face staring back at me, smiling amidst a backdrop of unimaginable luxury. It’s a secret they’ve kept well, living as they do in the modest house next door. I’ve known them for years, and all this time, I’ve never suspected a thing. Now, I find myself questioning everything I thought I knew, not just about them, but about myself. Why didn’t I notice? Why did I assume their life was as simple as it seemed? I feel the weight of my ignorance, and I wonder if I’ve wronged them by never seeing beyond the surface.
